newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone rebel leader orders men to back coup.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone rebel leader orders men to back coup.

text.p: Sierra Leone rebel leader Foday Sankoh on Wednesday ordered his fighters to be ready to reinforce the leaders of a weekend coup after Nigeria landed extra troops in a show of force.
"The politicians are our enemies, not the army," said Sankoh, who is currently held at a hotel in the Nigerian capital Abuja.
"All RUF (Revolutionary United Front) field commanders and troops should stand by for any reinforcement needed by Major Koromah to defend our sovereignty," Sankoh said in a broadcast on state radio.

Freetown's new strongman, Major Johnny Paul Koromah, said in a radio broadcast on Tuesday night that Sankoh had agreed to join his government and work for a lasting peace in the civil war that began in 1991.
A peace accord signed by Sankoh and ousted president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah last November has failed to hold, and Sankoh is reported to be disillusioned with the terms.
Koromah seized power in a weekend coup.
